exp033_connection_contract.prohibited_connection: EXP-034 does not fit a model, produce prediction scores, change EXP-033 code, or authorize EXP-033 execution
required_run_scope_references: EXP-034 canonical root result manifest path and SHA-256
exact runner-universe manifest path and SHA-256
exact training input release manifest path and SHA-256
exact target input release manifest path and SHA-256
exact feature-lineage manifest path and SHA-256
EXP-033 fold manifest path and SHA-256
exp033_connection_contract.runner_gate: EXP-033 must bind one immutable universe version; predraw_v1 is 70 rows, while any later scratch version requires an explicit compatibility decision and cannot silently satisfy the frozen 70-row gate
exp033_connection_contract.schema_gate: exact 88 ordered feature names, dtypes, missing policy, category policy, and materializer version must match EXP-033

feature_input_release_schema.unknown_category_policy: training-frozen dictionary; unseen and non-top-k categories use the frozen all-zero reference encoding

feature_lineage_schema.derived_hash_rule: SHA-256 over canonical feature name, transformation identity, and lexicographically sorted unique dependency content hashes
feature_lineage_schema.race_aggregate_rule: dependencies include every effective runner card and every safe prior-history record that determines the aggregate

governance_execution_boundary.current_main_blocker: ordinary schema-v2 run scopes do not bind execution_kind and current Research OS rejects real-data RUNNING; a versioned ordinary real-data run contract must be human-reviewed and merged before materialization
governance_execution_boundary.prepare_authority: implementation and synthetic fixture tests only after a verified APPROVED_TO_PREPARE grant and lifecycle transitions
governance_execution_boundary.real_data_authority: actual source reading and materialization require a distinct verified APPROVED_TO_RUN grant and RUNNING real-data lifecycle

hash_and_manifest_contract.artifact_hash: SHA-256 over exact serialized artifact bytes
hash_and_manifest_contract.logical_manifest_digest: SHA-256 over normalized canonical JSON bytes without a trailing LF
hash_and_manifest_contract.serialization: UTF-8, Unicode preserved, sorted JSON object keys, compact separators, NaN and Infinity forbidden; JSONL rows end with LF

label_eligibility_contract.abnormal_or_void_race: entire race label-ineligible for EXP-033; retained with official reason
label_eligibility_contract.audit_population_rule: preserve every declared identity and every official status in the append-only reconciliation ledger
label_eligibility_contract.dead_heat: entire race label-ineligible for EXP-033 because duplicate ranks may not be tie-broken or invented
label_eligibility_contract.declared_field_feature_rule: pre-race field aggregates use the bound effective declared universe and are never reconstructed by post-result filtering
label_eligibility_contract.effective_materialization_rule: exclude a scratch or nonstarter only when its official state was available before the bound prediction event; preserve it in the audit universe and version diff
label_eligibility_contract.finish_rank_gap: entire race label-ineligible for EXP-033; no compaction or renumbering
label_eligibility_contract.nonstarter: not label-eligible and not an effective starter; retained in the reconciliation ledger
label_eligibility_contract.race_level_policy: a historical race is EXP-033 label-eligible only when every effective starter has one completed official result and the official integer finish ranks form an exact unique permutation 1..n
label_eligibility_contract.scratched: not label-eligible and not an effective starter; retained in the universe ledger
label_eligibility_contract.unfinished_or_disqualified: entire race label-ineligible for EXP-033; no row deletion or rank renumbering

release_versioning_contract.baseline_version: predraw_v1 preserves exactly five races and 70 declared identities including 44 scheduled_pending_draw rows
release_versioning_contract.canonical_ordering: schema-defined stable sort before serialization and hashing
release_versioning_contract.change_log: every added, removed, or changed race_id/horse_id field is recorded with old/new payload hashes, reason, and source timestamps
release_versioning_contract.content_addressing: per-row canonical payload SHA-256, whole-artifact SHA-256, and canonical manifest SHA-256
release_versioning_contract.identity: stable release_family_id plus integer release_version plus canonical manifest digest
release_versioning_contract.immutability: append-only; no overwrite and no mutable latest alias
release_versioning_contract.parent_link: every version after v1 records the exact parent manifest digest
release_versioning_contract.unknown_or_unexplained_change: fail-close; never fold unknown bytes into a frozen release

saturday_postdraw_update_contract.frozen_run_scope_rule: a postdraw child version cannot replace the predraw version in an already approved run scope; bind one exact version or obtain a new approval
saturday_postdraw_update_contract.identity_change_rule: unexpected addition or replacement is fail-closed and requires a newly approved scope; scratch state is represented as a child version, not deletion from history
immutable_artifacts: canonicalizer code/config/environment hashes already bound to the run
permitted_state_changes: official jockey or carried-weight correction with source evidence
regenerated_artifacts: target 88-feature input child version when any effective field dependency changes

source_envelope_schema.hash_encoding: lowercase SHA-256 hex over canonical UTF-8 source payload

mandatory_fail_close: missing or invalid source content hash
source payload and content hash mismatch
any target-race result or future result dependency
source_time_as_of_contract.race_atomicity: materialize every runner in a race/event-time batch before applying any completed result from that batch to history state
source_time_as_of_contract.received_at_authority: authoritative acquisition evidence only; filesystem mtime and generation time are forbidden substitutes
source_time_as_of_contract.same_event_time_atomicity: all races sharing one event time use the same pre-update history snapshot
